ev.d_t_bondage.title: The Bond
ev.d_t_bondage.text: Under the terms of a loan, {npc} is now bound to serve in the creditor's household until every last drachma is worked off. The nome scribe merely shrugs: the papers are in order.
ev.d_t_bondage.pay.ok: You laid the silver before the creditor and took the contract. It was torn up right there, before witnesses.
ev.d_t_bondage.petition.success: The strategos read the petition and judged the terms extortionate. {npc} came home that same day.
ev.d_t_bondage.petition.failure: The petition lay in the office for half a year and came back refused. The scribes had to be paid for every line.
ev.d_t_bondage.share.ok: You took on half the work yourself: after your own field, the creditor's. Your back aches, but the term is halved.
ev.d_t_bondage.leave: Everyone answers for their own debts
ev.d_t_bondage.leave.ok: {npc} didn't say a word to you as {g=npc_sex:he was|she was} led away.
